name: Simple Addition
description: Yup, yet another trivial problem. You just have to add two integers! Oh, not easy enough? Sure, let’s say that they’re positive as well. Now it should be trivial, right?
input: The input consists of two lines, each containing a positive integer less than $10^{10\, 000}$. Oh right…I forgot to mention that the integers can be quite large.
output: One line containing the sum of the two integers.
